In view of the above our report is modified to the extent of Rs. 222.04 lakh. Reason and the steps taken by the listed entity: The Company is of the view that most of the amount has been received in current quarter hence no provision has been made for the same. 12. In accordance with IND AS 16 ‘Property, Plant and Equipment’ issued by Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, the company has calculated the depreciation on the revised carrying amount (after revaluation) of PPE. Accordingly, the new depreciation is higher than the original deprecation. The amount of additional depreciation charged excess on revalued assets, has been moved though Profit & Loss Account. Further, the company has transferred the amount of excess depreciation net of tax impact (if any) has been moved from revaluation reserve to retained earnings. 13.
